description: This PHP source file defines the EmpUsTaxExemptionController class within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It manages employee US tax exemption views and permissions within the application, interacting with services like CountryService to set up data components for frontend rendering.

classes.name: EmpUsTaxExemptionController
classes.description: Controller for handling employee US tax exemption view and permissions, extending BaseViewEmployeeController. It sets up Vue components with data such as provinces and statuses, and manages access control based on employee data.

methods.name: getCountryService
methods.description: Returns an instance of CountryService via dependency injection.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and Vue components for rendering the employee's US tax exemption view, setting permissions and handling bad request if employee number is missing.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Specifies the data group 'tax_exemptions' for capability permission checks.
